title: 第9章 再见曾子昂第10章 犬坊
content_zh:
离开东峰的陈知白，并没有直接返回私人袇房，而是绕道去了一趟万兽苑。
万兽苑，乃老律观产业，专司培育，售卖各类飞禽走兽。
陈知白入苑，买了一对食虫蝠、一对鼠耳蝠，又购置两颗魂灵珠。
蝙蝠未花多少钱，一颗下品魂灵珠，却花了一两银子，正是杂役一个月的衣单费。
而这点魂灵，不过相当二三百只田鼠的汲取量。
“没钱难修仙啊！”
陈知白心中轻叹，径直回了私人袇房。
掩上门，室内清寂。
他盘膝坐于蒲团上，取出一粒下品魂灵珠。
所谓魂灵珠，其实就是一枚塞满魂灵的鼠魂，以特殊手法祭炼过，外表补了几道特殊兽纹，加强了封印。
下品魂灵珠之上，还有中品、上品，区别只是魂灵含量更高，盛放魂灵的容器，也变成了兔魂、羊魂、猪魂……等等。
陈知白率先学习田鼠兽纹，也正是为了能够吞吐这下品魂灵珠。
他仔细观摩那额外增补的兽纹，闭目推演一番，随即驱使聚兽箓拓印出田鼠兽纹，又增补几笔，印在魂灵珠上。
霎时，魂灵珠门户大开，一团精纯魂灵涌入体内，令他呼吸微微一窒。
之前篆刻田鼠兽纹亏空的魂灵，瞬间弥补回来，还让他魂魄壮大了几分。
“痛快！”
陈知白心中暗赞，目光投向竹笼，双瞳立即化为兽形道箓。
笼中，食虫蝠缩在角落，兽纹涣耀而出，结构比田鼠要复杂数倍，丝丝缕缕，交织如网。
再看另一笼金丝蝙蝠，静伏不动，周身隐现的兽纹却令他心神一震。
那已非平面纹路，而是层层叠叠，像极了鬼工球，如活物呼吸般明灭律动，复杂精微处，胜过食虫蝠数十倍不止！

“这就是灵兽的兽纹？难怪道箓难修！”
陈知白低语。
观中弟子，近半终身难登入玄境，他之前一直无法理解，现在终于明白了。
据说，聚兽箓若想圆满，非上万普通兽纹打底。
若以灵兽兽纹为基，也需数百之数。
数百道这般律动兽纹？
想想便觉得肝疼！
“学吧，学无止境，太深了。”
陈知白吐了一口气，摒除杂念，指尖凌空，先模仿起食虫蝙蝠纹路。
一般来说，相同物种，兽纹会有重复部分。
因此学习高级兽纹之前，最好先临摹同属低级兽纹，熟悉一二，虽然浪费些许精力，却能提高成功率。
这世上，素来都是从零到一最难。
别看陈知白凝聚田鼠兽纹，花了十来天，记忆食虫蝙蝠兽纹，却仅用了半个晚上，便记个七七八八，估摸着最多两天就能凝聚而出。
索性他又琢磨一番金丝蝙蝠兽纹，直到倦意上涌，这才吹熄油灯，上塌歇息。
翌日清晨，陈知白准时来到传功堂。
堂内已换了一批新面孔，约二三十人，气息大多青涩。
“陈师弟？”
一声惊喜低呼传来。
陈知白侧目，却见曾子昂一脸喜色：“果真是你，我还以为看错了。”
陈知白微笑拱手：“看来曾师兄，也是聚兽箓？”

“正是！”曾子昂连连点头。
content_en:
After leaving Dongfeng, Chen Zhibai did not return directly to his private room, but took a detour to the Ten Thousand Beasts Garden.
The Ten Thousand Beasts Garden is Laoluguan's property, specializing in cultivating and selling all kinds of birds and beasts.
Chen Zhibai entered the garden and bought a pair of insect-eating bats, a pair of myotis bats, and two soul beads.
Bat didn't spend much money on a low-grade soul bead, but he spent one tael of silver, which was exactly what the handyman paid for his clothes for a month.
This amount of soul is only equivalent to the intake of two to three hundred voles.
"It's hard to cultivate immortality without money!"
Chen Zhibai sighed in his heart and went straight back to his private room.
Close the door, the room is quiet.
He sat cross-legged on the futon and took out a low-grade soul bead.
The so-called soul bead is actually a rat soul filled with souls. It has been refined with a special method, and several special animal patterns have been added to the surface to strengthen the seal.
On top of the low-grade soul beads, there are middle-grade and high-grade soul beads. The difference is that the soul content is higher, and the container holding the soul has also become a rabbit soul, a sheep soul, a pig soul... and so on.
Chen Zhibai took the lead in learning the field mouse animal pattern just to be able to swallow this low-grade soul bead.
He carefully observed the additional animal pattern, closed his eyes and deduce it, then used the beast gathering pot to rub the vole animal pattern, added a few more strokes, and printed it on the soul bead.
In an instant, the soul orb's portal opened wide, and a ball of pure soul poured into his body, suffocating his breath slightly.
The soul that was lacking in the previous seal carving of the field mouse animal pattern was instantly made up for, and his soul became a little stronger.
"Happy!"
Chen Zhibai secretly admired it in his heart and cast his gaze towards the bamboo cage, his pupils immediately transformed into beast-shaped Taoist baskets.
In the cage, the insect-eating bat huddled in the corner, with animal patterns gleaming out. The structure was several times more complex than that of the field mouse, with strands of strands intertwined like a net.
Looking at another cage of golden bats, they were motionless, but the animal patterns looming around them shocked him.
It was no longer a flat pattern, but layered on top of each other, like a ghostly ball. It flickered and flickered like the breath of a living creature. Its complexity and subtlety were dozens of times better than that of an insect-eating bat!
"Is this the animal pattern of a spiritual beast? No wonder the Taoist ritual is so difficult to repair!"
Chen Zhibai whispered.
The disciple of Guanzhong has been unable to enter the mysterious realm for nearly half his life. He has never been able to understand it before, but now he finally understands.
It is said that if the beast-gathering urn is to be perfect, it must be made with tens of thousands of ordinary animal patterns.
If the spirit beast patterns were used as the basis, hundreds of them would be needed.
Hundreds of these rhythmic animal patterns?
Just thinking about it makes my liver hurt!
"Learn, there is no end to learning, it's too deep."
Chen Zhibai took out a breath, got rid of distracting thoughts, raised his fingertips in the air, and first imitated the pattern of an insect-eating bat.
Generally speaking, animal patterns of the same species will have repeated parts.
Therefore, before learning high-level animal patterns, it is best to copy low-level animal patterns first and become familiar with them. Although it wastes a little energy, it can increase the success rate.
In this world, going from zero to one is always the most difficult thing.
Even though it took Chen Zhibai more than ten days to condense the field mouse pattern and memorize the insect-eating bat pattern, it only took him half a night to memorize it. It is estimated that it can be condensed in two days at most.
He simply pondered the pattern of golden bats and beasts again, until he felt tired, then he blew out the oil lamp and lay down to rest.
Early the next morning, Chen Zhibai arrived at Chuangong Hall on time.
There have been a group of new faces in the hall, about twenty or thirty people, and most of them have a green atmosphere.
"Junior Brother Chen?"
A low cry of surprise came.
Chen Zhibai looked sideways and saw Zeng Ziang's face was filled with joy: "It's really you, I thought I saw it wrong."
Chen Zhibai smiled and cupped his hands: "It seems that Senior Brother Zeng is also a Beast Gatherer?"
"Exactly!" Zeng Ziang nodded repeatedly.
